- TOTAL revenue reached £67.4k TW versus £50.9k LW, a WoW gain of 32.5%, and £21.4k LY, a YoY gain of 214.4%.
- TOTAL volume TW was 31,218 units across 1,940 orders.
- EMPIRE DESIGN ROSETTE led TW at £3,277.92, holding a 4.9% share of TOTAL revenue.
- EMPIRE DESIGN ROSETTE added £3,265.42 WoW and £3,265.42 YoY.
- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER posted £2,529.33 TW for a 3.8% share, down £2,122.41 WoW.
- ASSORTED COLOUR MINI CASES recorded £1,551.15 TW at a 2.3% share, up £1,479.60 WoW; SET/2 RED RETROSPOT TEA TOWELS rose £598.00 WoW.
- CHILLI LIGHTS fell £1,100.77 WoW, a decline of 69.3%, and JAM MAKING SET WITH JARS fell £829.96 WoW, while DOLLY GIRL LUNCH BOX rose 28.9% WoW.
- The top five products, including JUMBO BAG RED RETROSPOT at £1,482.34 TW and WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER at £1,119.63 TW, made up 14.8% of TOTAL revenue TW.
